user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking where check-in and check-out are the same date to be rejected so that same-day bookings are not allowed.

positive.title: Ensure booking is successful when check-in and check-out dates are different
steps: Select a check-in date that is 2 days from today
Select a check-out date that is 3 days from today
positive.expected_result: The booking should be created successfully with the provided check-in and check-out dates.

negative.title: Reject booking when check-in and check-out dates are the same
steps: Select today's date as the check-in date
Select today's date as the check-out date
negative.expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating that same-day bookings are not allowed.

edge.title: Handle booking when check-in and check-out dates are the last minute before cutoff
steps: Select a date which is the current date and time as check-in date
Select the same date a minute later as check-out date
edge.expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating that same-day bookings are not allowed.
